item.title: 76ers star Joel Embiid sits out against Trail Blazers to rest right knee after an off day
item.description: PORTLAND, Ore. (AP) — Philadelphia 76ers star Joel Embiid did not play against the Portland Trail Blazers on Monday night to rest his right knee after an off day. Embiid is averaging 26.6 points, 7.5 rebound and 3.9 assists this season.

item.title: Four players ejected after Pistons and Hornets tussle in physical game won by Detroit
item.description: CHARLOTTE, N.C. (AP) — A fight between the Detroit Pistons and Charlotte Hornets in the third quarter of Monday night's game, resulted in four player ejections.

item.title: Injured Warriors star Stephen Curry to sit out All-Star Game with lingering right knee injury
item.description: SAN FRANCISCO (AP) — Stephen Curry will sit out the All-Star Game in Los Angeles because of his troublesome right knee that sidelined the Golden State Warriors star for a fourth straight game Monday night against Memphis.

item.title: Thunder prospect Nikola Topic makes his G League debut after knee injury, cancer treatment
item.description: OKLAHOMA CITY (AP) — Oklahoma City Thunder prospect Nikola Topic has made his NBA G League debut after recovering from a major knee injury and undergoing cancer treatment.

item.title: Donovan Mitchell, James Harden rally Cavaliers to 119-117 win over Nuggets
item.description: DENVER (AP) — Donovan Mitchell scored 32 points, including two free throws with 0.9 seconds left after James Harden's tying 3-pointer, and the Cleveland Cavaliers rallied to beat the Denver Nuggets 119-117 on Monday night.

item.title: Jalen Williams returns from injury, leads Thunder past Lakers 119-110 with SGA, Luka sidelined
item.description: LOS ANGELES (AP) — Jalen Williams scored 15 of his 23 points in the second half of his return from a 10-game injury absence, and the Oklahoma City Thunder snapped their two-game skid with a 119-110 victory over the Los Angeles Lakers on Monday night.

item.title: Camara has a career night and the Trail Blazers use a 49-point third quarter to top 76ers 135-118
Pistons snap Hornets' 9-game streak with 110-104 win in game marred by fight, ejections
item.description: Cade Cunningham had 33 points and nine rebounds, and the Detroit Pistons hung on to beat Charlotte 110-104 on Monday night, snapping the Hornets’ nine-game winning streak in a wild game that included a fight and four player ejections .

item.title: Israeli strikes kill 3 people in Gaza, hospital says
item.description: DEIR AL-BALAH, Gaza Strip (AP) — Israeli military strikes on Monday killed three people west of Gaza City, according to the hospital where the casualties arrived.
